label: KarooFireFly
description: Automatic smart bike light control based on time of day and ambient light. Supports ANT+ lights (via Karoo pairing) and Magicshine BLE lights (via Bluetooth). Per-light configuration with protocol-specific modes, time-based and ambient light sensor automation, radar warn flash for rear lights, zone change notifications, and manual override via BonusActions.
releaseNotes:
* Add support for iGPSport VS800 lights
* Update Karoo SDK (karoo-ext) to 1.1.9
